turns.t: Doctor, it's our son Rohan, he's three months old. He spits up after every single feed, and I'm worried he isn't keeping enough down.
Waaah. ~
Hello, little man. Thank you both for bringing him. Let me hear it from you first, Mum. How often does he spit up?
After every feed, doctor. Every single one.
That's not right. It's not every feed. Maybe one or two a day, and it's only a little.
It is every feed, I do the night ones, you're asleep.
I'll note that you remember it differently, and we'll see how he looks. Is he feeding well otherwise?
He's hungry all the time. He takes about ninety millilitres, or maybe a hundred and twenty, I'm not sure. I don't measure carefully. ~
That's helpful. Is he bottle-fed or breast-fed? ~
Formula only. We changed formula last month. ~
Why did you change it?
My sister says he's allergic to cow's milk formula, but I don't know what the reaction was.
Thank you. I'll note that. Is he vomiting forcefully, or is it just milk coming up? ~
Just milk dribbling out, mostly. ~
Is there any green or bloody vomit, or a swollen tummy?
No. None of that.
Has he had any fever, or diarrhoea? ~
No, nothing like that. ~
What have you been giving him, if anything?
Colic drops, five drops with each feed, I think.
She gives them, but I forget half the time when I do the evening feed.
Thank you for being honest. I'll weigh him and check his temperature. ~
He's been gaining, the health visitor said so. ~
Weight 6.2 kilograms, temperature 36.7.
Is that good? ~
That's a healthy weight for three months. Let me feel his tummy and look at him. ~
Of course.
His tummy is soft, no lumps, and he looks well.
So he's fine? ~
He seems well, and growing well. This sounds like reflux, which is very common at this age, and he's not showing any warning signs.
What can we do? ~
I'd like to start a sachet of infant Gaviscon, one sachet with each feed, mixed in the milk.
And the drops? ~
We can stop those for now. Keep him upright for twenty minutes after each feed, and try smaller, more frequent feeds.
I'll do the evening ones properly. ~
Come back in three weeks, or sooner if he vomits forcefully, goes green, or stops feeding.
We will. Thank you. ~
